secure channel reception bypass
Upstream requirements:

If a message is configured to be
SecOC
received and the attribute
securedRxVer-
ification
is set to false, then

Communication Management
• the Authentic message part shall be extracted and processed
• the
VerificationStatus
shall be set to
VerificationStatusResult
